SELECT t.IMEI AS imei, CASE WHEN m.device_id IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(m.line_id, '') ELSE b.cable_key END AS cable_key, COALESCE(l.name, c.cable_name, CASE WHEN m.device_id IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(m.line_id, '') ELSE b.cable_key END) AS cable_name, t.CREATED_AT AS last_wave_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, t.CREATED_AT, NOW()) AS age_seconds, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.payload_json, '$.network.offlineThresholdSeconds')) AS offline_threshold_seconds FROM ( SELECT IMEI, MAX(CREATED_AT) AS CREATED_AT FROM DEVICE_RAW_FRAME GROUP BY IMEI ) t LEFT JOIN managed_device m ON m.device_id = t.IMEI COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN wave_device_bind b ON b.imei = t.IMEI COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN managed_line l ON l.line_id = (CASE WHEN m.device_id IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(m.line_id, '') ELSE b.cable_key END) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN cable_info c ON c.cable_key = (CASE WHEN m.device_id IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(m.line_id, '') ELSE b.cable_key END) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ORDER BY t.CREATED_AT DESC
